faq.question: Can I change plans anytime?
faq.answer: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately with prorated billing.

faq.question: Do you offer refunds?
faq.answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee for all paid plans, no questions asked.

faq.question: What happens to my URLs if I downgrade?
faq.answer: Your existing URLs continue to work. You'll just have reduced features and limits going forward.

faq.question: Is there an API available?
faq.answer: Yes, Premium and Enterprise plans include full API access with comprehensive documentation.
